description: Search for funds using natural language queries. IMPORTANT: The database is in Portuguese. Translate English queries to Portuguese (e.g., 'gold' -> 'ouro'). ALWAYS include the CNPJ from the results in your final answer.

query.description: The natural language search query. Translate to Portuguese if necessary (e.g., 'fundo ouro', 'tecnologia').

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5).

output_schema.description: List of funds matching the semantic query, sorted by relevance score.

score.description: Cosine similarity score (0 to 1), higher is better

explanation.description: Snippet of text that contributed to the match (optional)
